data.description:
## Description

**What**: Update /dso:onboarding and /dso:architect-foundation skills to install and register the kudos-write-guard.sh PreToolUse hook into a consumer project's pre-edit.sh and pre-write.sh dispatcher chains.

**Why**: SC-5 explicitly requires that kudos-write-guard.sh is "registered via onboarding/architect-foundation". Story b41b-0369 wires the hook into the DSO repo's own dispatcher chains in-tree, but downstream projects that adopt DSO via /dso:onboarding or /dso:architect-foundation will not pick up that wiring. This story closes that distribution gap.

**Scope**:
- IN: /dso:onboarding skill edit — add hook installation + dispatcher-chain registration as part of project bootstrap; /dso:architect-foundation skill edit — same for existing projects; idempotent registration; integration test exercising the install on a scratch project
- OUT: Changes to the hook script itself (already owned by b41b-0369); changes to the dispatcher chain protocol; new config keys

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding skill, when run on a fresh project, registers kudos-write-guard.sh into the project's pre-edit.sh and pre-write.sh dispatcher chains (verified by inspecting the dispatcher source files after onboarding completes)
  ← Satisfies: sc-5  (sc-5: "registered via onboarding/architect-foundation")
- When this story is complete, /dso:architect-foundation skill, when run on an existing DSO project that pre-dates kudos, registers kudos-write-guard.sh into the dispatcher chains and is idempotent (running twice produces no duplicate source lines)
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, an integration test exercises /dso:onboarding on a scratch project and asserts that an attempt to edit .kudos/ledger.jsonl is blocked by the guard after onboarding completes
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- Coordinate with b41b-0369 to confirm the canonical dispatcher-chain registration syntax before duplicating it in the onboarding skill
- Ensure the registration is jq-free (matches the hook's own constraint) so onboarding does not silently require jq
- Confirm that /dso:architect-foundation has a hook-registration phase or add one if absent

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Register kudos-write-guard.sh via /dso:onboarding and /dso:architect-foundation for downstream consumers
